messages.text: *Hark, mortal!* By 14:00 today, thou shalt conjure the Zammad container scrolls, lest the Docker demons consume thy soul!
*Hark, mortal!* By the stroke of 12:00, thou shalt conjure the sacred Zammad Docker scroll, lest the deployment demons consume thy soul!
*Hark, mortal!* By the tenth bell of the clock, have thy Zammad Docker incantations and scrolls of documentation forged and ready, lest the digital demons consume thy container!
*Hark, mortal!* By the third bell of the morn (08:00 sharp), thy Zammad Docker scroll must be forged, lest the ancient deployment demons awaken!
